request: api key expiry reminders: name of key, service, expires on. warn 14 days before

  row card gap 2 tap edit k

request: Fabric needed for shalwar kameez: enter my height, chest and sleeve length and whether I want a wide or slim shalwar. Gives me metres of cloth.

checklist.item: inputs for height, chest and sleeve length
choice of wide or slim shalwar
gives breakdown for kameez and shalwar

program:
app " Shalwar Kameez" cloud ocean
setting chest num = 20 "Chest length"
setting sleeve num = 20 " sleeve length"
let wide = max(chest * 100, chest)
let slim = max(sleeve * 100, sleeve)
row gap 3
  stack grow align center card
    "Chest" bold
    round(wide * 100 / max(chest, 1)) big
  stack grow align center card
    "Sleeve" bold
    round(slim * 100 / max(sleeve, 1)) big
if wide > slim
  "Wide cloth" color warn
if slim > wide
  "Slim cloth" color good
describe:
Shalwar Kameez, in the ocean colours.
You can change: "Chest length": number, starts at 20; " sleeve length": number, starts at 20.
Works out:
- wide is the larger of chest times 100 and chest.
- slim is the larger of sleeve times 100 and sleeve.
Shows:
- text: "Chest".
- text: wide times 100 divided by the larger of chest and 1 rounded.
- text: "Sleeve".
- text: slim times 100 divided by the larger of sleeve and 1 rounded.
- if wide is more than slim:
  - text: "Wide cloth".
- if slim is more than wide:
  - text: "Slim cloth".

request: ludo dice for the kids, big dice face with dots and a roll button

checklist.item: shows a visible dice face with dots or a big number
a button rolls it and gives random 1 to 6

program:
app "Ludo" dice ocean
table dice roll num 1..9
state kid num = 1
let heads = count(dice)
"Total" heads "dice" big
draw 100, 100 width 220
  rect 2, 6, 88, 92 radius 14 fill ink
  rect 92, 14, 6, 82 radius 12 fill ink
  circle 12 + 82 * sin(42 * kid), 5, 12 fill ink
row gap 1
  button "Roll" tap set kid = random(heads)
button "Next" tap set kid = random(heads)
"Darts:" head
each dice sort at as d
  if index = kid
    stack card
      d.roll big
      button "Next" tap set d.roll = d.roll + 1
row gap 1
  each [1, 2, 3, 4, 6]
    button it tap add dice roll = it
describe:
Ludo, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- dice: roll: number, 1 to 9. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- heads is how many dice entries.
Remembers while you use it: kid, starting at 1.
Shows:
- text: "Total", heads, "dice".
- a drawing made of rectangles, circles.
- a button "Roll"; a tap sets kid to a random whole number from 1 to heads.
- a button "Next"; a tap sets kid to a random whole number from 1 to heads.
- text: "Darts:".
- for each dice sorted by at:
  - if its position is kid:
    - text: the roll of the dice.
    - a button "Next"; a tap sets the roll of the dice to the roll of the dice plus 1.
- for 1, 2, 3, 4, 6:
  - a button the value; a tap adds a dice with roll set to the value.
